videos.headline: Peyton Woodring shanks 43-yard FG attempt for Georgia
Florida QB Aaron Philo throws a terrible INT while falling
Ellis Robinson IV comes up with an interception
Bo Walker crosses goal line for 1-yard TD
Quintavius Johnson drops opposing QB for the sack
Chris Cole scores 66-yard defensive TD to pad Georgia's big lead
Braylon Conley grabs interception vs. Florida Gators
Tramell Jones Jr. rushes in for 2-yard TD
